source_document.title: Of Conks & Cons
source_document.author: Christian Eichhorn
source_document.copyright_note: Hand-authored summaries and structural facts for internal retrieval experiments; not a reproduction of the source text.

must_not_answer: what actually happened at the Longmont table
current campaign canon unless promoted by adaptation/canon mapping

module_summary.premise: A magical tuber/conk is stolen, sold to a desperate village boy, planted, and grows into a grotesque attacking tree in Hempholm.
module_summary.surface_problem: The tree threatens the Jove family home and attacks creatures that come near it.
module_summary.deeper_problem: The tree has a hollow root network beneath the village inhabited by root-like caretakers and protected by a deeper plant-metal structure.
adventure_shape: decision about strange child and future consequences

setting_context.source_world: Forgotten Realms / Western Heartlands source context
setting_context.adaptation_warning: Regional geography and Faerun references are source-module context and should not be treated as Elderwyld or Longmont campaign canon without explicit adaptation.
landscape_tone: rural roads vulnerable to brigands, beasts, and old strange powers

locations.name: Hempholm
locations.summary: A small hemp-growing village of roughly eighty residents in the source module, with additional outlying farms.

locations.name: The Shacks
locations.summary: A rough lodging and tavern area on Hempholm's outskirts where travelers and migrant workers can stay cheaply.

locations.name: Morwin's Store
locations.summary: Hempholm's general store, dusty and run by Morwin Blackwell; sells basic goods, farming equipment, and household quantities of potent hemp.

locations.name: Saladin's Mobile Emporium
locations.summary: A gaudy traveling merchant wagon that is much larger inside than outside, run by the elderly elf Saladin.

locations.name: The Jove Home
locations.summary: The Jove family home sits near the grotesque tree, which occupies the garden and damages the house.

locations.name: The Grotesque Tree
locations.summary: A sickly, armored-looking, thorned, magical tree with metallic leaves; it attacks creatures that come too close and may retaliate against ranged aggression.

locations.name: Hollow Root Corridors
locations.summary: Warm, hollow, stone-or-metal-feeling root tunnels beneath Hempholm that connect to the deeper heart of the plant.

locations.name: The Marrow
locations.summary: A central chamber where root corridors converge around a wooden helix and a glowing/translucent sack containing a strange child-like being.

npcs_and_creatures.name: Torbin Jove
npcs_and_creatures.summary: The boy who bought and planted the magical conk/tuber, hoping it would help feed his family; now fears consequences from his father and village.

npcs_and_creatures.name: Mark Jove
npcs_and_creatures.summary: Torbin's angry and worried father, focused on the damage to his home, lost food, family survival, and the need for adventurers to solve the tree problem.

npcs_and_creatures.name: Morwin Blackwell
npcs_and_creatures.summary: Old, hard-of-hearing, poor-sighted store owner who sells basic goods and hemp blends; irritated by Saladin's presence.

npcs_and_creatures.name: Saladin
npcs_and_creatures.summary: A very old elf merchant/mage with a magical wagon, unbidden thoughts, money, and a strange remaining item for sale.

npcs_and_creatures.name: Narfi Granitetooth
npcs_and_creatures.summary: A grieving dwarven healer-priest drinking in the Shacks after the murder of her daughter; can be moved toward mercy and service.

npcs_and_creatures.name: Bill the Belly
npcs_and_creatures.summary: Proprietor associated with the Shacks and the Meal n' Moonshine competition.

npcs_and_creatures.name: Lord Fiddlestick
npcs_and_creatures.summary: The thief/con artist who stole the magical conk/tuber and sold it to Torbin in the source module backstory.

npcs_and_creatures.name: Korden
npcs_and_creatures.summary: A worried source-hook NPC connected to the stolen conk and the mages' guild.

npcs_and_creatures.name: Paelias Sian
npcs_and_creatures.summary: A later investigator sent to erase evidence, compensate witnesses, and track the strange child or adventurers.

npcs_and_creatures.name: Grotesque Tree
npcs_and_creatures.summary: Huge magical plant threat with long reach, hard bark, thorned branches, vulnerability to fire, ability to strike/grapple/throw, and metallic leaves.

npcs_and_creatures.name: Caretakers
npcs_and_creatures.summary: Root-like beetle/plant creatures from the hollow root network that retaliate after the surface tree is destroyed.

npcs_and_creatures.name: Guardian
npcs_and_creatures.summary: A deeper root-network guardian with iron-reinforced spike-like attacks and a needle-barrage style ability.

npcs_and_creatures.name: Child in the Helix
npcs_and_creatures.summary: A green, bark/stone/metal-inflected child-like being contained in a glowing sack within a wooden helix, creating a moral and future-campaign decision.

beats.title: Arrive at Hempholm
beats.summary: Characters arrive and immediately perceive the village's central problem: a grotesque tree threatening a family home and nearby villagers.

beats.title: Investigate the Grotesque Tree
beats.summary: Characters can examine the tree, identify shiny metallic leaves, sense arcane magic, and infer a magical root system beneath the village.

beats.title: Small Problems Around the Village
beats.summary: Hempholm includes optional small social/tool hooks like a broken distillery, gem cutting, and a food/drink competition.

beats.title: Advancing Tree Danger
beats.summary: If players delay, the tree grows, damages homes, risks spreading fire, or mauls villagers who try to attack it.

beats.title: Premature Celebration
beats.summary: If the visible tree is destroyed without catastrophe, villagers celebrate in the Shacks with food, ale, stories, children, and lowered guard.

beats.title: Rampage of the Caretakers
beats.summary: Hours after the tree is destroyed, root-like caretakers emerge from underground to attack villagers and structures in retaliation.

beats.title: Down Into the Root System
beats.summary: Openings torn through the village lead into warm hollow root corridors beneath Hempholm.

beats.title: The Marrow
beats.summary: At the center of the root network, characters encounter a guardian, a helix structure, metal resin, and a strange child-like being.

beats.title: Mages' Guild Cleanup
beats.summary: A guild agent can later seek to erase evidence and pursue the child or the adventurers.

tree.range_and_tactics: Attacks creatures near it and can retaliate against ranged threats; source stats include long reach, grappling/snaring, and throwing.
tree.fire: Fire is a potential answer but risks spreading through the village.

caretakers.role: Second-wave minions and evidence that the tree was only the visible part of a deeper system.
caretakers.behavior: Attack villagers/structures and eventually return underground or flee if enough are destroyed.
caretakers.fire: Afraid of fire in the source module.

root_descent.role: Turns the local crisis into a dungeon-like follow-up.
